shortDescription: North Korean hacking group Lazarus Group has stolen a cumulative $11.87 billion in crypto assets, according to on-chain analyst Darkfost. According to Foresight News, the total equals 45% of North Korea’s 2025 GDP and 35% of its gross national income.
